newsitem.title: USA: U.S. citizens warned to be cautious in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: U.S. citizens warned to be cautious in Colombia.

text.p: The State Department on Friday warned U.S. citizens in Bogota, Colombia to exercise caution in light of reports that guerrillas may conduct hostile operations in the next few days.

The U.S. embassy in Bogota issued a statement saying it had received information that guerrilla actions such as kidnappings might be planned in the coming days in the area surrounding Bogota, particularly on Sunday.
The embassy statement noted that guerrillas had traditionally targeted foreigners.
"All U.S. citizens in the Bogota area or travelers to that vicinity are advised to exercise caution," the statement said.
The embassy also recommended against any travel by U.S. citizens in Bogota outside the city limits of Bogota to Chia and La Calera.
